description: Test suite for the SimpleCache class, testing TTL-based JSON caching and removal functionalities in a Flutter application.

classes.name: CacheEntry
classes.description: Represents a cached JSON object along with its timestamp, used internally in SimpleCache.

classes.name: SimpleCache
classes.description: A service class that provides JSON caching with TTL support, using SharedPreferences for persistent storage.

methods.name: SimpleCache.putJson
methods.description: Stores a JSON object under a specified key with the current timestamp.

methods.name: SimpleCache.getJsonIfFresh
methods.description: Retrieves a cached JSON object if it is within the specified TTL; otherwise returns null.

methods.name: SimpleCache.getJsonEvenIfStale
methods.description: Retrieves a cached JSON object regardless of TTL status.

methods.name: SimpleCache.remove
methods.description: Removes a cached JSON entry and its timestamp.
